# Deformable surface

Query target: `DEFORMABLE_SURFACE`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [points](#points) | read/write | current nodal positions |
| [restPoints](#restpoints) | read | rest nodal positions |
| [simElementIndices](#simelementindices) | read | sim-mesh connectivity |
| [velocities](#velocities) | read/write | nodal velocities |

## points

`f32`; units: [distance](units.md#length); frame: sim-mesh-local; semantic: point.

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Read | array, shape [elements], 3 lanes | scene device |
| Write | array, shape [elements], 3 lanes | scene device |

**Read:** requires [DirectGPU warmup](#directgpu-warmup), [Deformable](#deformable).

**Write:** requires [DirectGPU warmup](#directgpu-warmup), [Deformable](#deformable).

Sets simulation state; then evolves with simulation. Visibility: commit.
Preserves: inverse_mass.

## Conditions

### Deformable

Simulation-node state requires a CUDA context; no corresponding CPU simulation. Read membership follows available simulation meshes.

### DirectGPU warmup

Device-backed DirectGPU state requires a completed first step; a write never warms the simulation automatically.
